messages:
mara.docs: Heads up 14DD 0 I'm working on the retention docs (SOC2 + audit logs) and a migration guide for the new retention preset names. Found two issues: the Go SDK audit export snippet 404s and the console preset names changed (30d -> short, 365d -> standard). Need quick legal wording and an engineer check for cross-region behavior. PTAL.

eli.legal: thanks. For SOC2-friendly wording, avoid definitive statements about cross-region storage unless it's under customer control. Suggest: "Audit logs are retained according to tenant-configured retention settings. In cases where copies are maintained across regions for backup or failover, the same retention and access policies apply and are subject to the customer's region and key management settings."

mara.docs: good, concise. I'll slot that in. Also want two small scenario bullets to show what "short" and "standard" mean in practice.

taylor.eng: re: cross-region copies: our current flow is DR-only replication for tenants without strict residency flags. Replicas inherit TTL metadata so they expire per original retention window. KMS: we re-encrypt when copying across regions using the customer's configured CMK if provided, otherwise our managed key (documented elsewhere).

jamie.ux: quick product ask 639: can we add a tiny help link in the Console near retention presets to point to this guide? UX prefers a one-sentence summary + link.

mara.docs: drafting examples now. Also updated the Go snippet path: the example moved to /examples/audit_export.go in sdk-go repo. Will link to the example, not raw.

Draft content (w/ examples):
- Example A (short): tenant in us-east, retention: 30 days (preset: "short"). Logs are stored in-region; no replication by default.
- Example B (standard): tenant in eu-west, retention: 365 days (preset: "standard"). For DR, replicas may exist in other regions; replica data observes the same retention TTL and access controls.

Go SDK snippet to include (link to example):
```go
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"), redwood.WithRegion("eu-west-1"))
  // uses customer-managed KMS in region when configured
  resp, _ := client.AuditLogs.Export("tenant-abc", 365)
  fmt.Println(resp.URL)
}
```

mara.docs: also adding a small note: "For strict data residency, choose a Private deployment or contact sales."

eli.legal: minor tweak: change "replicas may exist" to "replicas may be created for DR" to emphasise it's not automatic. Otherwise LGTM.

taylor.eng: noted, and I'll open a repo redirect for the old Go path + add a small README line about the export sample. ETA today.

mara.docs: thanks 44D I'll open the docs PR once I swap the link and update the preset names. PR will include a migration table mapping old -> new names.

doc-bot: PR opened by mara.docs 528 - docs/audit-retention: add preset migration table, cross-region examples, and fix Go SDK example link (PR #963) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/963

jamie.ux: cool, I'll queue the Tooltip request with Console team. small copy: "Retention presets map to recommended retention windows; see docs for details."

mara.docs: perfect. Closing this thread after PR merges. Will ping if legal wants further edits.
